messages.subject: Project Zephyr - quick question on the Wexbourne licence
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Separate to the financing - on Project Zephyr, Wexbourne's procurement team have asked whether the software licence permits use across their three new distribution centres without an uplift. Could someone confirm against the executed licence when you have a moment? No urgency this week.

Thanks,
Aisha
